description: Java class demonstrating examples of using MockServerClient to match requests based on OpenAPI definitions, including loading OpenAPI specs from URLs, files, classpath, and literals, as well as updating expectations.

classes.name: OpenAPIRequestMatcherExamples
classes.description: Class providing example methods for matching requests using OpenAPI specifications with MockServerClient.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByHttpUrl
methods.description: Matches request loaded from an OpenAPI JSON URL.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPIOperation
methods.description: Matches request for a specific OpenAPI operation by operationId.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByFileUrl
methods.description: Matches request loaded from a local file URL.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByClasspathLocation
methods.description: Matches request loaded from a classpath resource.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByJsonStringLiteral
methods.description: Matches request using an OpenAPI definition provided as a JSON string literal.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByYamlStringLiteral
methods.description: Matches request using an OpenAPI definition provided as a YAML string literal.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPIOperationTwice
methods.description: Matches request for an OpenAPI operation exactly twice.

methods.name: updateExpectationById
methods.description: Updates an expectation with a specific OpenAPI operation ID.
